ad_info.reference_style: Premium minimalist product hero ad: the real bottle as the single hero standing on a folded blue jean, under a bold two-line headline and a short subtitle
ad_info.angle_used: Identidad / aspiración: que el jean te horme, al natural

global_identity.color_palette: Brand palette: hot fuchsia #E6177F (main accent), deep magenta #B0105E, dark plum #2B1226, bottle black #0E0E10, bubblegum pink #FF8CC0, pale blush pink #FBE3EE and white #FFFFFF. Secondary colors for this variation: deep denim blue #1E3550 (background) and classic mid-blue denim #4A6E99 (the folded jean), with a soft fuchsia back light.
global_identity.visual_style: Clean, bold and feminine premium supplement hero ad, the real bottle sharp and identical to the photo.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Confident and aspirational, calm studio mood, plenty of negative space.
global_identity.graphic_language: Smooth plain background with negative space, one small rounded pill, clean high-contrast typography readable on a phone. No sparkles, flares, particles or competing objects.
global_identity.text_typography: Headline in Montserrat ExtraBold, uppercase; subtitle and seal in Inter (Medium / SemiBold). Maximum three text levels.

creative_objective: Say the core desire in one line with the object that sums it up (a folded jean) and the real bottle as the hero, with no person, so a cold audience that does not know the brand understands the promise in two seconds.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The bold headline at the top. 2) The large bottle standing on the folded jean, centered. 3) The short subtitle under the headline. 4) The small registration pill at the bottom.
art_direction.composition_style: Centered, symmetrical composition. The text stack is centered in the top area; the bottle stands slightly below the vertical center on top of a neatly folded blue jean, seen from a gentle low angle so the bottle feels heroic.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Headline 6-22% of the height, up to 88% of the width, 2 lines. Subtitle 24-28% of the height. Bottle centered, about 48-52% of the canvas height, from about 33% to 84% of the height. Folded jean under it, about 26-74% of the width and 78-90% of the height. Registration pill centered at about 92-96% of the height. Even safe margins of about 6-8%; nothing touches the edges.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Soft studio key light from the upper left, a thin fuchsia rim light along the right edge of the bottle, a very soft, low-intensity fuchsia back light behind the bottle that fades smoothly into the denim blue background (no flares, no sparkles), soft contact shadow of the bottle on the jean and of the jean on the implied surface.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square canvas with a smooth deep denim blue background and a very soft fuchsia back light behind the center. Headline and subtitle stacked and centered in the top area. The real bottle, large and centered, stands on a neatly folded blue jean in the middle and lower part of the canvas, with a soft shadow. A small registration pill is centered at the bottom. No other elements.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Brand-tinted backdrop with depth that makes the bottle pop
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Smooth deep denim blue #1E3550 gradient, slightly darker at the corners, with a very soft fuchsia back light behind the bottle. No texture, no pattern, no particles.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Main visual anchor; shows exactly what is being sold
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: The real bottle exactly as in the attached product photo, front view from a gentle low angle, upright, label fully readable, standing on the folded jean.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Under the bottle, about 26-74% of the width and 78-90% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: The object that symbolizes the desire, acting as the product's pedestal
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: A neatly folded classic mid-blue denim jean with visible stitching and a back pocket edge, folded into a flat rectangle. No brand labels, no leather patch text.

detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Stops the scroll and states the desire
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Two lines, white, with 'AL NATURAL' in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Directly below the headline, centered, 24-28% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Completes the headline with how and without what
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: One short white line with a middle dot separator.

detected_visual_blocks.position: Bottom center, about 92-96% of the height
detected_visual_blocks.visual_function: Trust: the sanitary registration given by the brand
detected_visual_blocks.adaptation_rule: Small rounded pill in pale blush pink #FBE3EE with dark plum text. Text only, no logos, no icons other than a tiny check-shield.

forbidden_additions: Logos or brand marks outside the bottle label
Any trust seal other than the single registration pill
Extra props that compete with the product (only the folded jean)
Sparkles, lens flares, particles or glitter

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 premium product hero supplement ad. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product: do not redesign, replace or reinterpret it. Smooth deep denim blue #1E3550 background, slightly darker in the corners, with a very soft, low-intensity hot-fuchsia back light behind the center that fades smoothly into the blue; no texture, no sparkles, no particles. Top center (6-22% of the height, up to 88% of the width) a two-line extra-bold uppercase white headline in Montserrat ExtraBold with the words 'AL NATURAL' in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0; directly below it (24-28% of the height) one short white subtitle line in Inter Medium. In the center, from about 33% to 84% of the height, the real product standing large and upright, seen from a gentle low angle so it feels heroic, label fully readable: a matte black cylindrical plastic supplement bottle, about 1.6 times taller than wide, glossy hot-pink/magenta screw cap with a repeating small white 'VITALABH' pattern, solid hot-pink band on the bottom fifth, black label with a small pink VITALABH emblem, a huge bold white condensed 'AGUAJE', 'COMPLEX 3 EN 1' with '3 EN 1' in pink-red, a thin hot-pink banner 'SUPLEMENTO ALIMENTICIO EN CÁPSULAS', a bold italic hot-pink 'TRIPLE ACCIÓN' with a swoosh, three small pink-outlined boxes '200mg AGUAJE', '400mg FENOGRECO', '200mg MACA NEGRA' and '60 CÁPSULAS'. The bottle stands on a neatly folded classic mid-blue denim jean (about 26-74% of the width, 78-90% of the height) with visible stitching and a back pocket edge, no brand patch. Soft studio key light from the upper left, a thin fuchsia rim light on the right edge of the bottle, soft contact shadows. Bottom center (92-96% of the height) a small rounded pale blush pink pill with a tiny dark plum check-shield icon and dark plum text. Clean, airy, lots of negative space, everything readable on a phone. No people, no other objects.

text_layers.reference_position: Top center, first element of the text stack
text_layers.text_style: Montserrat ExtraBold, uppercase, each line about 8-9% of the canvas height, 2 lines, centered, white; 'AL NATURAL' in bubblegum pink #FF8CC0
text_layers.text: QUE EL JEAN TE HORME, AL NATURAL

text_layers.text_style: Inter Medium, about 3.6% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered, white
text_layers.text: 2 cápsulas al día · Sin agujas ni quirófano

text_layers.reference_position: Bottom center, inside the small pale blush pill
text_layers.text_style: Inter SemiBold, uppercase, about 2.1% of the canvas height, 1 line, centered, dark plum #2B1226

mandatory_visual_elements: The real bottle, large and centered, seen from a gentle low angle
A neatly folded blue denim jean under the bottle as its pedestal
Smooth deep denim blue background with a very soft fuchsia back light
Soft contact shadow under the bottle
Small pale blush registration pill at the bottom center
final_generation_exclusions: No people, bodies, mannequins or hands.
No brand labels or leather patches on the jean.
No sparkles, lens flares, glitter or particles.
Do not add any visual module that is not described in this prompt.
Do not add any text that is not listed in the EXACT VISIBLE TEXT section.

Do not add CTA buttons, prices, badges, benefits, icons, trust seals, ratings, testimonials, bottom bars, discount labels, offer boxes or extra claims unless they are explicitly listed in detected_visual_blocks or text_layers.
Preserve the translated structure exactly. Do not complete or improve the layout with additional advertising elements.
meta_policy_check: All visible text has been sanitized for Facebook/Instagram Ads compliance. No prohibited claims, no false guarantees and no direct personal attribute callouts.
language_rule: All visible text inside the generated image must be written in Spanish.
